reviews.review_text:
Mark Rudkin
Hemel Hempstead, United Kingdom545 contributions
0
Unbelievable food and location….
Sep 2026 • Couples
Had dinner here a few days ago and it was superb fast service and beautifully prepared and served. Great atmosphere and fantastic location in the heart of the old quarter in Hanoi . Great menu choices and so much to choose from. I had a traditional special Vietnamese pancake filled with seafood and served with rice pancakes and fresh herbs mint, coriander and basil leaves. Also a dipping sauce and lettuce the idea is that you make yourself a rice roll with all the ingredients and add the pancake. Tasty and delicious. The main course was Deep Fried Tilapia with mango fish sauce which was devine and beautifully served had a local Viet Pale Ale to drink which was definitely different that UK beers and was refreshing different. Also had crispy deep fried straw mushrooms which were crispy and crunchy and vegan spring rolls packed with fresh vegetables and so tasty. The whole experience was delicious and fantastic and wonderful and would definitely recommend this place thank you guys……Great value for money and hardly any waiting time quick service and attentive staff.
